name: Monomem
description: Self-hosted shared memory for AI coding agents: one SQLite file on the user's machine, shared by every connected tool. Each note carries a server-stamped writer, version history and undo. Reads and ordinary saves keep Guard's usual handling; forgetting, replacing, merging, purging history, changing trust or quarantine, and queueing or approving tasks are gated on review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Tools use only local SQLite; no model is called. Semantic search may send notes and queries to MONOMEM_EMBED_URL (default: local Ollama at localhost:11434); Monomem warns if remote. HTTP binds 127.0.0.1 by default and ships no tunnel.

A default install registers only nine tools (state_write, state_read, state_search, state_list, state_delete, catch_up and the supersede preview/confirm/undo trio). The rest appear only when MONOMEM_TOOLS opts them in.

Stdio is a tokenless local operator (written_by=stdio); clients are indistinguishable. memory_quarantine, trust_policy, memory_history_purge, memory_consolidate, task_approve need MONOMEM_STDIO_ADMIN_TOOLS=1. Per-agent scoped HTTP tokens stamp written_by.

Default MONOMEM_LINT: every write rejects known secret formats, quarantines suspected prompt injection for operator review and warns on bare high-entropy strings. It can be loosened (e.g. warn), limiting these guarantees to default.

Supersede preview/confirm; undo reverses it. state_delete hides notes from all agents, drops vectors; operators can restore. monomem delete is permanent. SQLite secure_delete is on; WAL/backups may retain copies. Review required: hides shared memory.
task_put can queue a command task for the separately run, unpublished command runner, and task_approve lets it run; both stay on review.

Use npx -y monomem@<version> mcp (monomem setup); mcp is required. The package-launcher schema example omits the subcommand. node <path>/cli.js mcp or Windows cmd /c npx preserves Guard's normal handling.
